boundary_rationale: Onset at 11:2, weighed from both sides. Behind the seam, rp:1Cor.11.1 Μιμηταί μου γίνεσθε, closes the argument over food and conscience with an imitation command (web:1Cor.11.1 “Be imitators of me, even as I also am of Christ.”) and opens no fresh subject. Across the seam, rp:1Cor.11.2 Ἐπαινῶ δὲ ὑμᾶς, opens a statement of praise whose object is the delivered traditions (rp:1Cor.11.2 καθὼς παρέδωκα ὑμῖν τὰς παραδόσεις); the praise verb returns negated at rp:1Cor.11.17 οὐκ ἐπαινῶ,, so the pair brackets the material before the meal discussion (EXTRACTED: device ids epaino and ouk_epaino at 11:2, 11:17 and 11:22). No row opens at 11:3: rp:1Cor.11.3 Θέλω δὲ ὑμᾶς εἰδέναι, states the thesis that the praise of 11:2 leads into, and its connective ties it back to 11:2 (INFERRED). Close at 11:12, weighed from both sides. Inside, rp:1Cor.11.12 τὰ δὲ πάντα ἐκ τοῦ θεοῦ. ends the reciprocity qualification that rp:1Cor.11.11 Πλὴν introduced, which answers the argument from the creation account in 11:7-11:10 (INFERRED). Beyond, rp:1Cor.11.13 Ἐν ὑμῖν αὐτοῖς κρίνατε· begins asyndetically and turns from argument to an appeal to the hearers' own judgment, followed by the argument from nature and the appeal to custom (INFERRED). This close seam rests on the text alone: there is no RP pilcrow at 11:13, and no device from the device listing stands there (EXTRACTED), so the evidence for it is one-sided and confidence stays medium-low.

At 11:11 SBLGNT reads the two clauses in the other order inside a sign pair, sbl:1Cor.11.11 πλὴν οὔτε ⸂γυνὴ χωρὶς ἀνδρὸς οὔτε ἀνὴρ χωρὶς γυναικὸς⸃ ἐν; the qualification stands in both texts. Further RP/SBLGNT differences inside the span touch no seam (EXTRACTED from the RP/SBLGNT difference list). The WEB carries three footnote markers on the word head at 11:3; no seam rests on them. Divided reading (REPORTED): interpreters divide over the word head (kephale) at 11:3, read as authority by many complementarian readers and as source or origin by many egalitarian readers, and over the covering, read as a veil, as a way of wearing the hair, or as long hair itself, and as a local custom or a standing practice by readers in several traditions. These readings are attributed to their holders; the row prefers no reading, and its seams do not depend on which one is held.

No device from the device listing and no RP pilcrow stands at 11:13 (EXTRACTED), so the onset rests on the turn in argument alone, which keeps confidence medium-low. Close at 11:16, weighed from both sides. Inside, rp:1Cor.11.16 ἡμεῖς τοιαύτην συνήθειαν οὐκ ἔχομεν, appeals to a shared custom, widened by rp:1Cor.11.16 οὐδὲ αἱ ἐκκλησίαι τοῦ θεοῦ., and sets aside further dispute; it ends the discussion of covering. Beyond, rp:1Cor.11.17 Τοῦτο δὲ παραγγέλλων οὐκ ἐπαινῶ, turns to the assemblies at their meals and negates the praise of 11:2 (EXTRACTED: device ids epaino and ouk_epaino at 11:2 and 11:17). This close seam is also the seam between the head-covering material and the meal material.

boundary_rationale: Onset at 11:17, weighed from both sides. Behind the seam, rp:1Cor.11.16 οὐδὲ αἱ ἐκκλησίαι τοῦ θεοῦ. ends the covering discussion with an appeal to the custom of the assemblies. Across it, rp:1Cor.11.17 Τοῦτο δὲ παραγγέλλων οὐκ ἐπαινῶ, withholds the praise given at 11:2 and names a fresh subject, the gatherings (web:1Cor.11.17 “together not for the better but for the worse.”). Through the span and past it, the gathering verb (the stem of rp:1Cor.11.17 συνέρχεσθε.) stands in 5 verses of chapter 11 in RP, at 11:17, 11:18, 11:20, 11:33 and 11:34 (MEASURED by the lane script gen_w4, skeleton match). Close at 11:22, weighed from both sides. Inside, the report introduced by rp:1Cor.11.18 ἀκούω σχίσματα ends in a run of questions and the negated praise rp:1Cor.11.22 Ἐπαινέσω ὑμᾶς ἐν τούτῳ; Οὐκ ἐπαινῶ., which returns to the wording of 11:17 and closes the report as an inclusio (EXTRACTED: device ids ouk_epaino at 11:17 and 11:22, epaineso at 11:22). Beyond, rp:1Cor.11.23 Ἐγὼ γὰρ παρέλαβον ἀπὸ τοῦ κυρίου opens a received tradition (EXTRACTED: device ids parelabon and paredoka at 11:23). Its causal connective (gar) ties the tradition to the questions of 11:22 as the ground of the withheld praise, so the far side of the close seam is weaker than a fresh start; the gar link is disclosed here, the WEB paragraph start at 11:23 decides nothing, and confidence stays medium.
